findings.evidence: The sibling file establishes the convention: `DimensionVector.lean` states `titsForm_vertexPreReflection` (150), `titsPolarForm_vertexPreReflection` (161) and `bijOn_vertexPreReflection` (172) only in the `vertexPreReflection` packaging, with `coe_vertexReflection` (135, `@[simp]`) bridging to `vertexReflection`; no result there is duplicated into the automorphism form. Coxeter.lean:308-310 and 330-332 show the wrapper proofs are the one simp rewrite that convention relies on.
findings.fix: Delete both automorphism-packaged `_eq_self_iff` lemmas and keep only the `vertexPreReflectionProd` forms; since `coe_vertexReflectionProd` is `@[simp]` (line 151), a goal `vertexReflectionProd Q hl v = v ↔ v = 0` is normalized to the pre-reflection form by `simp` and then closed by the general theorem.
findings.issue: `vertexReflectionProd_eq_self_iff` (line 305) and `vertexReflectionProd_eq_self_iff_of_anisotropic` (line 327) restate `vertexPreReflectionProd_eq_self_iff` (line 296) and `vertexPreReflectionProd_eq_self_iff_of_anisotropic` (line 317) with the extra hypothesis `hl : ∀ i ∈ l, IsEmpty (i ⟶ i)`, which the conclusion does not need — under `hani` a vertex may carry ≥2 loops and the pre-form still applies, so these are strictly less general duplicates. Their proofs are literally `simp only [coe_vertexReflectionProd]; exact <pre version>`.

summary: The fixed-vector material is at the right level: the general per-vertex lemma is proved first, the all-vertices and anisotropic statements are derived from it, and the Nodup/exhaustion/loopless hypotheses are all genuinely used. The two automorphism-packaged `_eq_self_iff` lemmas are strictly weaker restatements of the adjacent pre-reflection theorems.
